items.section: Added 2026-11-11 -- THE CW OPEN COUNTS NO ZONES (issue 277)
items.title: **Two QSOs, the score.** Log two QSOs with different callsigns on one band (e.g. K6RB 1 ROB, W1AW 2 JOE on 20 m CW). Calls reads 2 and the score reads **2 x 2 = 4** (before this change it would have counted their zones too). Work K6RB again on 40 m: a new QSO (points 3), no new multiplier, score **3 x 2 = 6**.
